name: Eta Child
body:
Your parents were poor, but hard-working. They taught you that you should never be ashamed of honest labor, no matter how vile others might think it.

Benefit: You gain a +1 trait bonus to Profession (any one) and a +2 trait bonus to Fortitude saves against effects which would sicken or nauseate you.
